audience: businesses in Africa who send SMS, airtime and data with Africa's Talking

useCases.title: Check your account and data wallet balance
useCases.text: The AI reads the balance of your SMS and airtime wallet and the balance of your mobile data wallet.

useCases.title: Read incoming SMS on your shortcode
useCases.text: The AI fetches received SMS in batches, oldest first, and sums up what customers wrote.

useCases.title: Send an SMS to a list of numbers
useCases.text: The AI sends one text to up to 100 numbers after you approve the numbers and the text. It uses account credit.

useCases.title: Top up airtime or send data bundles
useCases.text: The AI sends airtime or data bundles to up to 25 numbers after you approve each number and amount. This spends credit and cannot be reversed.

useCases.title: Check the status of an airtime or data transaction
useCases.text: The AI looks up a transaction by its id and shows status, amount or product, and destination.

useCases.title: Call numbers and check the voice queue
useCases.text: The AI places an outbound call to up to 10 numbers from your number, and reads how many calls are queued per voice number.
